Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared last quarter. Our procurement and security teams are doing their final vendor security review and have one remaining ask: a brief "interim assurance" (bridge/addendum) that covers any material changes or exceptions between the report end date (2025-12-31) and today (2026-04-05).

Can you provide this by end of next week (COB 2026-04-10)? They prefer a signed PDF. Happy to receive a draft first if that helps.
